meta.title: In-place edits of a live stage disappear after the first bid
gaps: Verify that all three Edit controls are present before the first bid and then disappear on the same event: the prepared state already contains a bid and cannot be reset to the pre-bid state.

plan.title: Live RFQ edit controls disappear after first bid

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with one submitted vendor bid.
Reach the panels containing the in-place edit controls.
Order Details must not offer in-place editing after the first bid.
Terms & Conditions must not offer in-place editing after the first bid.
Savings must not offer in-place editing after the first bid.
